input: Write a postcard to my pen pal in Oslo

gold.taskTitle: Write a postcard to pen pal in Oslo
gold.taskDescription: Write and send a postcard to the user's pen pal who lives in Oslo, Norway.

questions.title: What is your pen pal's full name and mailing address?
questions.description: Collect the recipient's name and complete postal address in Oslo.

questions.title: What language should the postcard be written in?
questions.description: Determine whether the postcard should be in English, Norwegian, or another language.

questions.title: What is the main message or topic you want to share?
questions.description: Understand the core content or news the user wants to communicate.

questions.title: What tone should the postcard have?
questions.description: Clarify whether the tone should be warm, humorous, formal, nostalgic, or something else.

questions.title: Do you have a specific postcard image or theme in mind?
questions.description: Find out if the user wants a particular visual theme such as a local landmark, nature scene, or illustration.

questions.title: Are you writing this by hand or printing it digitally?
questions.description: Determine the format so the message length and layout can be planned accordingly.

questions.title: Is there a deadline by which the postcard needs to arrive?
questions.description: Establish any time constraints that affect when the postcard must be written and sent.
